svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A C-shaped ring 10 mm long, 1.6 mm wall, that springs over the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the cell and wraps 10 degrees past its sides on each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 21700 clip: 21.0 mm inside. 18650 clip: 18.3 mm inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Raised pad on top, 7 x 10 mm and 3 mm high, with a 2 mm hole down

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through it for the thermistor bead, which touches the cell;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a dab of thermal paste between bead and cell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print with the ring's axis vertical; no supports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push down over the cell between the holder's contact posts;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower edges stay at least 2 mm above the holder.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it grips the cell and does not slide when the lead is tugged.
